picks.title: welcome: Restore GitHub sign-in banner and enable by default
picks.summary: Signed-out users now see a GitHub sign-in button by default on the classic Welcome page instead of the invitation to try the Agents window.
picks.author: alexdima

picks.title: sessions: Promote New Chat on session rows by default
picks.summary: Eligible session rows now make New Chat the primary action by default, changing the action users reach first.
picks.author: alexdima

picks.title: Sessions: show application badge by default on Stable
picks.summary: Stable now shows the Agents window application badge by default, matching the fully rolled-out experiment.
picks.author: alexdima

picks.title: chat: support named and prompted Agent Host forks
picks.summary: The `/fork` command can now create a fork with a chosen title or immediately send a new prompt with attached context.
picks.author: DonJayamanne

picks.title: Add marketplace protocol links with user confirmation
picks.summary: New `vscode://` links can add plugin marketplaces or install a named plugin, with an explicit confirmation before either action.
picks.author: aeschli

picks.title: chat: download generated image batches as ZIP
picks.summary: Users can download all ready images in a generated batch as one ZIP instead of saving them individually.
picks.author: justschen

picks.title: Show a language-status warning for diagnostic highlight limits
picks.summary: Editor Language Status now warns when diagnostics are truncated or not highlighted, while the highlight limit rises from 500 to 5,000 markers.
picks.author: aiday-mar

picks.title: Stop delivering steering messages the user removed from the queue
picks.summary: Removing a queued steering message now actually withdraws it so the agent neither receives it nor adds it to the transcript.
picks.author: karthiknadig

picks.title: sessions: fix model picker and terminal startup in cloud sandboxes
picks.summary: Reopened Cloud Sandbox sessions now restore the model picker and start remote terminals in the host-reported directory rather than the local home folder.
picks.author: roblourens

picks.title: sessions: Find sessions by pull request number
picks.summary: The Agents window can now filter sessions by an associated pull request number, with or without a leading `#`.
picks.author: aeschli
